item.title: Marianas welcomes return of Philippine Airlines
item.description: (MVA) — The Marianas is celebrating the return of Philippine Airlines to the market, with twice‑weekly flights between Manila and Saipan set to begin on March 29, 2026. The post Marianas welcomes return of Philippine Airlines appeared first on Marianas Variety News & Views.

item.title: 11 complete 500 Sails ‘Lalayak’ sailing program
item.description: ELEVEN participants completed 500 Sails’ Lalayak sailing program and received certificates of completion during a ceremony Sunday morning at Guma Sakman. The post 11 complete 500 Sails ‘Lalayak’ sailing program appeared first on Marianas Variety News & Views.

item.title: Defense challenges dismissal of deportation charge
item.description: ATTORNEY Cong Nie has asked the federal court to order prosecutors to explain why they seek to dismiss the case against his client, Jianbing Zhao, who was indicted for obstructing his deportation from the Commonwealth of the Northern Mariana Islands. The post Defense challenges dismissal of deportation charge appeared first on Marianas Variety News & Views.

item.title: Friends of the Mariana Trench fault short comment window on offshore mining plan
item.description: THE Friends of the Mariana Trench have condemned the federal government’s handling of the public comment period for its Request for Information on potential commercial leasing of Outer Continental Shelf minerals offshore the Commonwealth of the Northern Mariana Islands. The post Friends of the Mariana Trench fault short comment window on offshore mining plan appeared first on Marianas Variety News & Views.

item.title: Feds extend comment period for deep-sea mining plan
item.description: THE U.S. Department of the Interior’s Bureau of Ocean Energy Management has extended the public comment period on the request for information and indications of interest for a potential minerals lease sale offshore the CNMI. The post Feds extend comment period for deep-sea mining plan appeared first on Marianas Variety News & Views.

item.title: MVA, CPA unveil new welcome signs at airports
item.description: THE Marianas Visitors Authority and the Commonwealth Ports Authority on Friday unveiled new welcome signs at the airports in Saipan, Tinian, and Rota, calling them more than markers as they are symbols of the islands’ culture, warmth, and hospitality. The post MVA, CPA unveil new welcome signs at airports appeared first on Marianas Variety News & Views.

item.title: Ralph to run for governor
item.description: THE NMI Republican Party is likely to hold a primary election for its gubernatorial candidate in the 2026 elections, party Chairman Patrick M. Cepeda said Saturday. The post Ralph to run for governor appeared first on Marianas Variety News & Views.

item.title: NMI heads toward health coverage ‘cliff’ as budget session delayed
item.description: NO emergency session, as urgently requested by Gov. David M. Norita warned on Sunday that the CNMI government “heads closer to the cliff with no insurance coverage for 7,000 people.” The post NMI heads toward health coverage ‘cliff’ as budget session delayed appeared first on Marianas Variety News & Views.
